primary_task: Add Aspire to a repo for the first time via `aspire new <template>` or `aspire init`, dropping the AppHost skeleton and handing off to aspireify.

requirements.name: aspire

any_of.name: aspire via dotnet tool install -g Aspire.Cli

requirements.evidence: INVOKES: aspire CLI (init, new, doctor); aspire init --language csharp --non-interactive
requirements.check: command -v aspire; npm view @microsoft/aspire-cli version; npm view @microsoft/aspire-cli-linux-x64 version; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 15 https://aspire.dev/
requirements.observed: not found; 13.6.0; 13.6.0; aspire.dev curl: (56) CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403

requirements.name: AppHost runtime (.NET 10 SDK or Node.js)
requirements.check: command -v dotnet; apt-get -s install dotnet-sdk-10.0; curl archive.ubuntu.com; node --version
requirements.observed: dotnet not found; apt simulation resolves dotnet-sdk-10.0 10.0.110 (archive/security.ubuntu.com reachable, 200); node v22.22.0

requirements.name: api.nuget.org
requirements.evidence: aspire new <template> (templates/SDK packages fetched from NuGet)

notes: Aspire CLI installable from npm (linux-x64 optional dep published); the curl installer host aspire.dev is blocked, and the official dotnet download hosts are blocked, but Ubuntu's dotnet-sdk-10.0 apt package resolves from reachable mirrors. NuGet egress for templates is inferred (not stated literally). C# path needs .NET 10; TypeScript path works with the existing Node 22.22.
